task_description:
# Ball Token with Path

Add a ball token that can be positioned and given a movement path like players. Show ball movement through passes and kicks in play animations.

## Rationale
Currently only players are shown. Tracking the ball's movement is essential for demonstrating complete plays involving kicks and handballs.

## User Stories
- As a coach, I want to show where the ball moves during a play
- As a player, I want to understand kick timing and target selection

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Ball token available on field
- [ ] Ball can be positioned via drag-and-drop
- [ ] Ball can have movement paths like players
- [ ] Ball animates along path during playback
- [ ] Can assign ball to a player (ball moves with player)
- [ ] Ball visually distinct from players
